name: sakura-monorepo
description: Sakura's npm-workspaces monorepo. legacy/ is the production single-file app (index.html/hub.html) — deploy.yml builds and publishes legacy/ exclusively. web/ was a React rewrite, discontinued 2026-08-31 and never deployed (see docs/history/web-migration/framework-migration-plan.md), kept in the repo only as history. worker/ is a Cloudflare Worker proposed in docs/ai-hosted-vault-design.md, not yet deployed.
